questions.q: What is the difference between seasonality and a cycle?
options: Seasonality has a fixed period; a cycle has no fixed length
A cycle is shorter than a season
why: Correct. A season repeats on a known calendar length; cycles rise and fall irregularly.

questions.q: Hourly data has a daily pattern. What is the period?
A trend line is y = 20 + 3·t. What is y at t = 7?
A series has trend 200 and seasonal factor 1.10 (multiplicative), noise ignored. What is the value?
An online shop's yearly peak in December is +500 orders at every level of sales, in all years. Which model fits?
why: Correct. The swing keeps the same absolute size.
A multiplicative swing would grow with the level.

questions.q: Sales swings grow from ±10 to ±40 as sales grow from 100 to 400. What do you do before fitting an additive model?
options: Take the logarithm of the series
why: Correct. The swings are about ±10% of the level, which is constant after the log.
Adding a constant does not change the relative swing.

questions.q: Which of these has a trend but no season?
options: Total number of registered users of a website
why: Correct. The count only goes up over time and does not repeat.
Traffic repeats every day and week.
